title: Etheree
tagline: A platform that can help people in need by paying the minimum earnings in the Ethereum ecosystem.
description:
Etheree(EEE) stands for Ethereum-based Elementary Earnings. 

Etheree's goal is to realize the ideal of providing a minimum earning to those in need, not a lot of income. 

Etheree(EEE) is a type of universal basic income that offers minimal earnings. 
Etheree consists of three main parts: Giver, Receiver, and Supporter.

1. "Giver" is the one who donates assets to Etheree. Giver can donate a variety of assets, including fiat currency, crypto currency, and physical assets.

2. "Receiver" is the one who receives basic earnings on Etheree. Anyone can receive a certain amount of EEE at regular intervals depending on the applicable conditions.

3. "Supporters" are those who participate in the community. You can support Etheree in a variety of ways and participate in various events to help.
how_its_made:
The Ethere (EEE) project consists of token creation, payment management, donation management, and user communication.

Based on Ethereum, you can register your address and receive basic earning through various wallet linkages. Various tokens based on sponsorship technologies can be donated on the platform.

Through sponsorship technology, transmission costs can be managed through efficient smart contracts and Layer 2 configuration, and safe operation is possible by applying a multisig wallet.

Sustainable platform operation is possible through the virtuous cycle of donation-efficient operation-earnings payment.

Through the website, users can understand and participate in the service, and it is particularly noteworthy in that it implements all services, such as registering their own wallet, saving to the registered wallet, and participating in donations to help others.
